## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a verified pinned tag. Use a bare tagged
reference without `docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  application-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

import gzip, pathlib
src='/workspace/inputs/identify.related.q1.tped.gz'
tfam='/workspace/inputs/identify.related.q1.tfam'
out='/workspace/inputs/identify.related.q1.vcf'
samples=[]
with open(tfam) as f:
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split()
        if len(p)>=2:
            samples.append(p[1])
assert len(samples)==205, len(samples)
with open(out,'w') as fo:
    fo.write('##fileformat=VCFv4.2\\n')
    fo.write('##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description=\"Genotype\">\\n')
    fo.write('#'+'\\t'.join(['CHROM','POS','ID','REF','ALT','QUAL','FILTER','INFO','FORMAT']+samples)+'\\n')
    n=0
    with gzip.open(src,'rt') as fi:
        for line in fi:
            p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            if len(p)<6:
                continue
            chrom, vid, cm, bp = p[0], p[1], p[2], p[3]
            als=p[4:]
            u=list(dict.fromkeys(als))
            # maintain biallelic assumption; choose reference/alt robustly
            if len(u)"'!=2:
                raise RuntimeError(f'"'{vid} has {len(u)} distinct alleles: {u[:10]}')
            if '<DEL>' in u:
                ref=next(a for a in u if a"'!='"'<DEL>')
                alt='<DEL>'
            else:
                # lexical is deterministic and VCF-acceptable; shorter is REF for indels
                ref=min(u)
                alt=max(u)
            gts=[]
            for a1,a2 in zip(als[0::2], als[1::2]):
                b1='0' if a1==ref else '1'
                b2='0' if a2==ref else '1'
                gts.append(f'{b1}/{b2}')
            fo.write('\\t'.join([chrom,bp,vid,ref,alt,'.','PASS','.','GT']+gts)+'\\n')
            n+=1
print('wrote',n,'variants, samples',len(samples),'size',pathlib.Path(out).stat().st_size)
